\chapter{Exam Radar: what is likely to be asked}
\label{ch:radar}
Built from 3 past papers (MS2022, MS2024, MS2025). $P$ = estimated chance the idea appears in your paper (recency-weighted frequency, smoothed with lecture time and seniors' lists). \textbf{EV} = $P\times$ typical marks $\times$ choice factor = marks at stake. This table is ranked by EV; the Important Questions chapter groups ideas by tier (A $\ge$60\%, B 35--59\%, C 15--34\%, D never asked) and orders them by EV inside each tier. \textbf{Yield} = EV per 30 minutes of study; the time-boxed study plans at the end pick by yield. With so few papers treat $P$ as a band (high / medium / low), not a promise.
